Crisp-clear deep-distance — no cloud, a clean pale-blue brick sky-baseplate, far ridges in lighter-grey slope-bricks suggesting depth, every brick edge sharp, a high cold clarity.
Low cloud-sea below the peaks — a level mass of white 1×1 round-plates plus cotton-elements massed at mid-mountain height, summits rising above the built cloud-sea like silent islands.
Morning valley-mist — cotton-elements plus white round-plates pooled along the valley floor between slope-brick walls, the upper ridges clear above, a still built softness at the base.
Gathering storm-cloud bank — dark-bley plus grey 1×1 round-plates plus cotton-elements stacked on one side of the sky-baseplate, a brick-shadow cast across the range below, heavy and ominous.

Golden atmospheric-haze — trans-clear plus trans-yellow tiles scattered across the deep-distance layer, far ridges softened into warm brick silhouettes, the classic built depth-haze of a late-afternoon sky.
Light snow-flurry — sparse white 1×1 round-plates seated on thin clear bar-rods across the frame, a few cotton-elements added, a gentle static built snowfall over the high peaks.
Rolling ground-fog — a static low layer of cotton-elements plus white round-plates across the forest floor and lake surface, trunk-columns and ridge-walls rising clean above the built fog-field.
High thin cirrus-streaks — narrow rows of white 1×2 plates plus 1×1 round-plates built high across the sky-baseplate, fair-weather wisps giving the vista a quiet airy ceiling.
Clearing-after-storm — a torn cloud-bank of grey plus white round-plates parted at centre, a shaft of open brick-sky over one ridge, the built drama mid-dissolution, still and tense.
Heat-haze shimmer — a subtle scatter of trans-clear tiles laid low over a desert plate-plain, light caught in the surface, a built suggestion of rising heat, dry and silent.
Pre-dawn overcast — a flat unbroken ceiling of medium-grey 1×1 round-plates plus dark-bley plates across the full sky-baseplate, the peaks barely differentiated below, a heavy muffled stillness.

High-altitude thin-air clarity — a deep-blue brick sky-baseplate, no cloud layer, far ranges in pale-grey micro-plates receding sharply, the built atmosphere almost absent, a cold stripped-back openness.
Autumn haze — a scatter of trans-orange plus trans-yellow tiles across the mid-distance layer, warm toned silhouettes of ridge-bricks softened behind the built colour-haze, golden and melancholy.

Dense fog-bank at treeline — cotton-elements plus white round-plates built into a solid horizontal band at exactly treeline height, canopy-tops and summit-bricks emerging above, the valley entirely consumed below.

Partial cloud-cover — alternating panels of white cotton-elements plus open blue-baseplate sections across the sky layer, a patchwork built ceiling casting uneven brick-shadow across the slope-fields below.
Thin coastal overcast — a pale uniform layer of light-bley 1×1 round-plates plus a sparse cotton-element scatter, the light flat and diffuse across the built shore, soft and featureless.
